integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the joint model definition, its optimization form, the scalar Gaussian example, the separate-model convexity theorem, and the concluding open question. The proof was independently reconstructed from the exact scalar event and does not rely on numerical experiments.
scientific_limitations: The nonconvexity proof is for the joint model at probability level \(p=1/2\) and uses the feasible exceptional point \((0,0)\). It does not establish nonconvexity for levels \(p>1/2\), nor does it contradict the source convexity theorem for the separate-chance model.
title: A scalar Gaussian counterexample to convexity of the joint chance-constrained LCP feasible set
